title: Earth orientation parameters: polar motion, UT1 - UTC, length of day and celestial pole offsets, daily since 1973 with a year of predictions (IERS Bulletin A, finals2000A)
provider: International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service (IERS), Rapid Service/Prediction Centre at the US Naval Observatory; distributed by the IERS Data Centre (BKG, Frankfurt)

latest.description: the whole series, renewed daily by the IERS (about 3.8 MB); fetch with --refresh for the latest measurements and predictions

format: Fixed-column text, one day per line (IERS, readme.finals2000A): year, month, day, MJD (cols 8-15); polar motion x_p, y_p in arcseconds (19-27, 38-46) with an I or P flag for measured or predicted (17); UT1 - UTC in seconds (59-68, flag at 58); LOD in milliseconds (80-86); dX, dY with respect to IAU 2006/2000A in milliarcseconds (98-106, 117-125, flag at 96); then the Bulletin B values. Read by the metrology domain's C++ (earth_orientation/eop.hpp).
coverage: 1973-01-02 to about a year after the retrieval; measurements to a few days before it, predictions after.
licence: IERS products are free of charge; the IERS asks that its products be cited (https://www.iers.org/IERS/EN/Organization/ProductCentres/ProductCentres.html).
citation: IERS Rapid Service/Prediction Centre, Bulletin A, finals2000A.all, https://datacenter.iers.org/data/9/finals2000A.all (retrieved on the date of retrieval.json). Petit, G. and Luzum, B. (eds.) (2010), IERS Conventions (2010), IERS Technical Note 36.
